scripts.build:bin: vite build && cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --release --features tauri/custom-protocol --bins && node -e "(async () => { const cp = await import('child_process'); const fs = await import('fs'); try { cp.execSync('taskkill /F /T /IM Sketch2Asset.exe /IM sketch2asset-mcp.exe', { stdio: 'ignore' }); } catch {} for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) { try { for (const f of fs.readdirSync('bin')) { if (f.endsWith('.old.exe')) try { fs.unlinkSync('bin/' + f); } catch {} } fs.copyFileSync('src-tauri/target/release/Sketch2Asset.exe', 'bin/Sketch2Asset.exe'); fs.copyFileSync('src-tauri/target/release/sketch2asset-mcp.exe', 'bin/sketch2asset-mcp.exe'); break; } catch (e) { if (i === 14) throw e; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } } })()"
